title: Add CSV export for expenses
pr_description: Adds a new export module so users can download their expenses as a CSV file. Supports an optional category filter and writes into an exports/ directory using the caller-supplied filename.

defects.description: Category filter is interpolated into the SQL string with an f-string instead of a bound parameter, allowing SQL injection through the category argument.
Caller-supplied filename is joined to the export directory without sanitization, so names like '../../etc/x' escape the exports directory (path traversal).
